=> x2 + 1/x2 = 3

questions.solution:
r sin q = 1 ..(i)

r cos q = √3 ..(ii)

dividing (i) by (ii),

(sin q/cos q) = 1/√3

So, √3 tan q + 1 = 1 + 1 = 2
